description: This file defines a feature for editing user data within an ASP.NET Core application, including the command, handler, and validation logic for updating user details.

classes.name: Edit.UserData
classes.description: Data transfer object for user information such as username, email, password, bio, and image.

classes.name: Edit.Command
classes.description: Request message encapsulating the user data for editing, implementing IRequest to be handled asynchronously.

classes.name: Edit.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validation class ensuring that the Command contains non-null user data.

classes.name: Edit.Handler
classes.description: Handles the process of updating user details in the database, including password hashing and mapping.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the edit command by retrieving the current user, updating their data, hashing the password if provided, saving changes, and returning the updated user envelope.
